name: live-qwen-to-glm-qa-v2-reverse
label: PREREGISTERED before any validation or evaluation number existed for this direction (4 hand-written exploratory cases had been run and are disclosed in docs/agent-progress.md)
question: Can GLM-5.3, served by the running vLLM server on the Sparks, answer a factual question about a passage that only Qwen3.8 (Studio, oMLX) has read, when the only thing it receives is Qwen's K/V translated into its own MLA latent cache?

evaluation_set.generator: scripts/live/gen_corpus.py --n 40 --seed 4242 --heldout-vocab (GLM-written prose from randomised fact sheets; names and places disjoint from every training list)
evaluation_set.item: one question per passage about ONE fact that survived into the prose; kind priority: code, person, time, ingredient, animal, colour, count, weight, room, day; fixed question template per kind (scripts/live/qa_eval.py)
evaluation_set.exclusions: a passage is dropped only if no listed fact survived verbatim or tokenization does not round-trip; decided before any model output is seen
evaluation_set.reuse: the same 40 held-out-vocabulary passages as the forward evaluation (local/live/gen_eval.jsonl, sha256 in configs/frozen.live-qa-v2.json). They were never used to fit or tune the reverse translator and no reverse-direction output on them exists at commit time.

translator: stacked-level ridge Qwen->GLM with variance restoration (local/live/stacked2_rev.npz, fitted on corpus2 train rows only). gain power in {1.0, 1.5} and memory copies in {4, 12} are chosen ONLY on validation passages (local/live/gen_val.jsonl); frozen with sha256 before the evaluation run, which is run once.
mechanism: TelepathyGlm53Connector (subclass of the owner's handoff connector) overwrites the fp8_ds_mla latent pages of a placeholder span in the request's own blocks after the engine step that computed them; the entries are tiled `copies` times across the span (NoPE attention: a log(copies) prior). Recurrent KDA state, pooled selector keys and the drafter window come from the placeholder tokens. DFlash speculative decoding and TP=2 stay on.

conditions.telepathy: Qwen K/V of the passage -> translator -> written into GLM's cache
conditions.wrong_memory: same, with the next item's memory (cyclic)
conditions.own_latents: control: GLM's own latents of the passage written back the same way (needs the text; not the telepathy channel)
conditions.text_in_prompt: control: the passage pasted into the prompt

decoding: greedy (temperature 0), non-thinking chat template, 160 new tokens
metric: exact match: the fact's value appears in the answer (case-insensitive substring)

pass_criteria.C1_content_specific: EM(telepathy) - EM(wrong_memory) >= 0.25 AND one-sided exact sign test on discordant items p < 0.05
pass_criteria.C0_valid: every telepathy/wrong/own request reports a completed write on rank 0; items whose write failed closed are retried once, then counted as misses
pass_criteria.verdict: PASSED if C1 and C2; PARTIAL if C1 only; otherwise FAILED

reported_regardless: EM per condition and per fact kind
known_limits: the reader's own prompt must be shorter than 128 tokens on this build (scheduler step boundary)
memory is a prefix span, no learned gate
writer is 4-bit MLX; reader cache is fp8
